payingUser: A frequent leisure traveller who packs for a family or repeats similar trips and rebuilds the same packing list every time.
paidUnit: Individual destination and season trip packs, such as a winter ski pack or a beach pack, each adding a prebuilt editable item list with a per-bag weight budget.
momentOfPayment: When the traveller opens a second destination pack before a booked trip and taps Add this pack, after one starter pack per install.
distinctnessSentence: Each pack is an editable list with a per-bag weight budget, where the measured 1M+ leader cannot edit its own travel dates and its own paid edition is rated 3.1.
day1RevenuePath: A free app with one starter pack, then a paid second destination pack bought in the days before a booked trip.
assumptionsUnverified: That travellers will buy destination packs instead of using the free leader, which has 1M+ installs and 42,087 reviews and is the highest-rated result on the query.
That a prebuilt pack is a purchase rather than a feature a free competitor copies in a week, since nothing in the format is defensible.
That repeat purchases recur often enough for this archetype, because a traveller who packs twice a year buys two packs a year at most.
